scenarios.title: Slow JOIN on Large Tables
scenarios.query: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count, SUM(o.total_amount) as total_spent FROM `project.dataset.customers` c LEFT JOIN `project.dataset.orders` o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
scenarios.issue: Query takes 45 seconds on 10M customer records and 100M order records

scenarios.title: Inefficient Window Functions
scenarios.query: SELECT user_id, event_time, event_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) as rn, LEAD(event_type) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_time) as next_event FROM `project.dataset.user_events` WHERE DATE(event_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
scenarios.issue: Window functions causing memory pressure and slot exhaustion

scenarios.title: Repeated CTE Calculations
scenarios.query: WITH daily_stats AS (SELECT DATE(timestamp) as date, COUNT(*) as events FROM `project.dataset.events` GROUP BY date), weekly_stats AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date, WEEK) as week, SUM(events) as weekly_events FROM daily_stats GROUP BY week) SELECT * FROM weekly_stats WHERE week >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
scenarios.issue: CTE is materialized multiple times causing redundant computation

scenarios.title: Unoptimized Aggregations
scenarios.query: SELECT product_category, DATE_TRUNC(order_date, MONTH) as month, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as unique_customers, SUM(quantity * unit_price) as revenue FROM `project.dataset.order_items` oi JOIN `project.dataset.orders` o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY product_category, month ORDER BY month DESC, revenue DESC
scenarios.issue: Multiple aggregations without proper partitioning strategy

scenarios.title: Suboptimal String Operations
scenarios.query: SELECT user_id, email, REGEXP_EXTRACT(email, r'@(.+)') as domain, CASE WHEN email LIKE '%gmail%' THEN 'Gmail' WHEN email LIKE '%yahoo%' THEN 'Yahoo' ELSE 'Other' END as provider FROM `project.dataset.users` WHERE LENGTH(email) > 5 AND email LIKE '%@%'
scenarios.issue: Multiple string operations on large text fields

optimization_patterns.partitioning: Use table partitioning on date columns to reduce data scanned
optimization_patterns.clustering: Cluster tables by frequently filtered columns
optimization_patterns.approximate_aggregation: Use APPROX functions for large-scale counts
optimization_patterns.denormalization: Strategic denormalization for frequently joined data
